## Sample Data

Pull with `rdhs`

```{r adam, eval = F}
library(rdhs)
# Login and cache settings come from code/rdhs.json (git-ignored, holds the
# password). Read it with rdhs's own reader, which also turns the data_frame
# setting into a function, and create the client from it. All rdhs calls below
# are given this client explicitly, so the working directory does not matter.
rdhs_cfg <- rdhs:::read_rdhs_config_file(here("code/rdhs.json"))
stopifnot(is.character(rdhs_cfg$password), nzchar(rdhs_cfg$password))
client <- client_dhs(config = rdhs_cfg, root = rdhs_cfg$cache_path)
cat("rdhs:", rdhs_cfg$email, "| project:", rdhs_cfg$project, "| cache:", rdhs_cfg$cache_path, "\n")

# The 100 sub-Saharan surveys of the analysis (99 for women, ZM2002 men only).
# The former query had no regional filter and pulled every country, India included.
surveys <- readLines(here("code/surveys.txt"))

# all formats of the recode files, so that a Stata file can stand in for a
# flat file that rdhs cannot read
all_ds <- dhs_datasets(
    surveyType = "DHS", 
    fileType = c("IR", "MR"),
    client = client) %>%
    filter(SurveyId %in% surveys) %>%
    mutate(
        fmt = toupper(substr(FileName, 7, 8)), # FL flat, DT Stata, SV SPSS, SD SAS
        sex = if_else(FileType == "Individual Recode", "female", "male")
    )
datasets <- filter(all_ds, fmt == "FL")
stopifnot(all(surveys %in% datasets$SurveyId))

# Some flat-file dictionaries (.DCF), mostly of French-language surveys, are
# latin1. rdhs reads them with brio::read_lines, which marks every line as
# UTF-8 whatever the locale, and the parser then stops with "input string is
# invalid". For those surveys use the Stata file of the same recode, which
# haven reads with its own encoding handling; the variables are the same.
get_one <- function(fn) {
    tryCatch(client$get_datasets(fn)[[1]], error = function(e) {
        # file names differ in case (".zip", ".ZIP"), so match on the upper-case stem
        stem <- toupper(sub("FL\\.ZIP$", "DT", fn, ignore.case = TRUE))
        alt <- all_ds$FileName[toupper(sub("\\.ZIP$", "", all_ds$FileName, ignore.case = TRUE)) == stem]
        if (length(alt) != 1) stop(fn, " could not be read and no single Stata file ", stem, " was found")
        message(fn, " could not be read (", conditionMessage(e), "); using ", alt)
        client$get_datasets(alt)[[1]]
    })
}
downloads <- lapply(datasets$FileName, get_one) # same order as datasets
datasets$used <- basename(unlist(downloads))
datasets %>% count(fmt_used = if_else(grepl("DT", used, ignore.case = TRUE), "Stata", "flat"))
```

```{r dhs_pull}
# both male and female
ooo <- bind_rows(o, oo)

# recode marital statuses
marital_recode <- c(
   never = "never in union" ,
   never = "never married" ,
   separated = "not living together" ,
   separated = "seperated" ,
   separated = "no longer living together/separated" ,
   union = "living together",
   union = "living with partner",
   NULL = "missing"
)
ooo %<>% mutate(marital_status = fct_recode(marital_status, !!!marital_recode))

#' Data cleaning
#'
ooo %>% 
    mutate(
        n_union = haven::as_factor(n_union), 
        n_union = fct_recode(n_union, NULL = 'missing'),
        age = floor((doi - dob) / 12), # completed years, as v012 (was round)
        afs = if_else(afs > 90, NA_real_, afs), # inconsistent, unknown
        afs = if_else(is.na(afs) & marital_status == "never", 0, afs), # fix missing
        afs = if_else((afs == 0 | is.na(afs)) & marriage_age != 0 & marital_status != "never", marriage_age, afs), # missing afs but aam say otherwise
        marriage_age = if_else(marital_status == "never", 0, marriage_age),
        n_union = if_else(is.na(n_union) & marriage_age == 0, "neverOnce", n_union), 
        n_union = if_else(is.na(n_union) & marriage_age != 0, "oneORmore", n_union), # as censored since missing in data
        across(where(is.labelled), zap_label)
    ) %>%
    filter(!(is.na(marriage_age) & is.na(afs))) %>%  # interim DHS does not have afs & aam, do they named differently
    filter(!is.na(marriage_age)) %>% # 225 had afs but not aam, can be done as censored but just removed here
    filter(n_union != "oneORmore") %>% # 2,761 ever-married women with missing v503 dropped (assumed missing at random)
    saveRDS(here('data/cleaned.rds'))
```

Calculate needed indcator for likelihood

```{r likelihood_prep}
library(haven)
readRDS(here('data/cleaned.rds')) %>% 
  select(lab, sex, afs, afm = marriage_age, dob, aai = age, u = n_union, ms = marital_status,
         weights, cluster, strata) %>%
  filter(weights != 0) %>%
  group_by(lab, sex) %>% # IR and MR files share the survey id, so normalise by sex as well
  mutate(
    weights = weights / 10^6, # https://www.dhsprogram.com/data/Guide-to-DHS-Statistics/index.htm#t=Analyzing_DHS_Data.htm&rhsearch=v005&rhhlterm=v005&rhsyns=%20
    n_eff = sum(weights)^2 / sum(weights^2), # effective sample size
    kish = weights * n_eff / sum(weights), # Kish weights
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n_eff) %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.labelled), zap_labels),
    ms = as.character(ms),
    id = 1:n(),
    cc = substr(lab, 1, 2),
    sv = substr(lab, 3, 6),
    ms = if_else(ms %in% c("married", "union") & u == "once", "M", ms),
    ms = if_else(ms %in% c("married", "union") & u != "once", "R", ms),
    ms = if_else(afs == 0 & afm == 0, "V", ms),
    ms = if_else(afs != 0 & afm == 0, "X", ms),
    ms = if_else(ms == "separated", "D", ms),
    ms = if_else(ms == "divorced", "D", ms),
    ms = if_else(ms == "widowed", "W", ms),
    # observed post-marriage cell (eight-state model): union order splits D and W
    cell = case_when(
      ms == "M" ~ "M",
      ms == "R" ~ "R",
      ms == "D" & u == "once" ~ "D1",
      ms == "W" & u == "once" ~ "W1",
      ms == "D" ~ "D2",
      ms == "W" ~ "W2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ # never married
    ),
    sex = if_else(sex == 'female', 'f', 'm'),
    yob = cmc_to_year(dob)
  ) %>% 
  select(-dob) %>% 
allot(tmp)

#' Design effect of the cluster sample, per survey and sex.
#' deff_total from svymean for the post-marriage cells, age at marriage and age
#' at first sex; it includes the effect of unequal weights, which the Kish
#' weights already remove, so only the clustering part deff_total / deff_w is
#' applied to the weights.
library(survey)
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")
deff_of <- function(d) {
  if (nrow(d) < 200 || all(is.na(d$cluster))) return(NA_real_)
  # one 0/1 indicator per post-marriage cell (NA for the never married), so that
  # svymean never builds a factor, which fails when a survey has a single level
  cells <- c("M", "D1", "W1", "R", "D2", "W2")
  for (lv in cells) d[[paste0("c_", lv)]] <- as.numeric(d$cell == lv)
  st <- if (any(is.na(d$strata))) NULL else ~strata
  des <- svydesign(ids = ~cluster, strata = st, weights = ~weights, data = d, nest = TRUE)
  em <- subset(des, !is.na(cell))
  sx <- subset(des, !is.na(afs) & afs > 0)
  # deff = "replace": compare with simple random sampling with replacement, so
  # the Kish-scale weights (mean about 1) are not taken as a population size
  dv <- function(f, ds) {
    r <- try(svymean(f, ds, deff = "replace", na.rm = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(r, "try-error")) return(c(est = NA_real_, deff = NA_real_))
    c(est = unname(coef(r)), deff = unname(deff(r)))
  }
  v <- c()
  for (lv in cells) {
    r <- dv(as.formula(paste0("~c_", lv)), em)
    if (!is.na(r["est"]) && r["est"] >= 0.01) v <- c(v, r["deff"])
  }
  v <- c(v, dv(~afm, em)["deff"], dv(~afs, sx)["deff"])
  median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
}
deffs <- tmp %>%
  group_by(lab, sex) %>%
  group_modify(~ tibble(
    deff_total = deff_of(.x),
    deff_w = nrow(.x) * sum(.x$weights^2) / sum(.x$weights)^2
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(deff_clus = pmax(1, coalesce(deff_total / deff_w, 1)))
write.csv(deffs, here("data", "deff.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
deffs %>% summarise(across(starts_with("deff"), list(med = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE))))

tmp <- tmp %>%
  left_join(select(deffs, lab, sex, deff_clus), by = c("lab", "sex")) %>%
  mutate(kish = kish / deff_clus) %>%
  select(-lab, -weights, -cluster, -strata, -deff_clus)

# Too big the dataset, do sequential insteads
cc <- unique(tmp$cc)
dir.create(here("data/cc8"), F)

parallel::mclapply(cc, function(i) {
cat(i, '\n')
tmp %>%
  filter(cc == i) %>% 
  mutate(neversex = afs == 0, neverwed = afm == 0) %>% 
  group_by(neversex, neverwed) %>% 
  group_modify( ~ {
    .x$VV = 0 # if (.y$neversex && .y$neverwed)
    if (!.y$neversex && .y$neverwed) {
      .x$VX = .x$afs
      .x$XX = .x$afs + 1
    }
    if (!.y$neversex && !.y$neverwed) {
      .x$VM = if_else(.x$afs >= .x$afm, .x$afm, NA_real_)
      .x$VX = if_else(.x$afs < .x$afm, .x$afs, NA_real_)
      .x$XX = if_else(.x$afs < .x$afm, .x$afs + 1, NA_real_)
      .x$XM = if_else(.x$afs < .x$afm, .x$afm, NA_real_)
    }
    if (!.y$neverwed) {
      # one post-marriage episode per ever-married person, ending in the observed cell
      .x$MM  = if_else(.x$cell == 'M',  .x$afm + 1, NA_real_)
      .x$MD1 = if_else(.x$cell == 'D1', .x$afm + 1, NA_real_)
      .x$MW1 = if_else(.x$cell == 'W1', .x$afm + 1, NA_real_)
      .x$MR  = if_else(.x$cell == 'R',  .x$afm + 1, NA_real_)
      .x$MD2 = if_else(.x$cell == 'D2', .x$afm + 1, NA_real_)
      .x$MW2 = if_else(.x$cell == 'W2', .x$afm + 1, NA_real_)
    }
    .x
  }) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    any_of(c("VV", "VX", "VM", "XX", "XM", "MM", "MD1", "MW1", "MR", "MD2", "MW2")), 
    names_to = 'trans', values_to = 'start'
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(start) %>% 
  select(-starts_with('never'), -u, -ms, -cell) %>% 
  group_by(cc, sv, sex, id) %>% 
  mutate(
    end = if_else(row_number() == n(), aai, lead(start)),
    A = substr(trans, 1, 1),
    Z = substr(trans, 2, nchar(trans)), # M, D1, W1, R, D2, W2 for post-marriage episodes
    d = end - start
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!(start == end & A != 0)) %>% 
  group_by(cc, sv, sex, yob, aai, afs, afm, start, end, A, Z, d) %>% # fit is now set per episode in run.r
  summarise(n = sum(kish), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  write.csv(here("data/cc8", paste0(i, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
},
mc.cores = 6
) %>% invisible()

# stepwise empirical for MS MD MW
hz_np <- function(fit_np) {
  df <- data.frame(
    time = fit_np$T_bull_Intervals[2, ],
    p_mass = fit_np$p_hat
  )
  agg_data <- aggregate(p_mass ~ time, data = df, FUN = sum)
  surv_prob <- 1 - cumsum(agg_data$p_mass)
  surv_estimates <- data.frame(
    time = c(0, agg_data$time),
    surv_prob = c(1, surv_prob)
  )
  n <- nrow(surv_estimates)
  hz_df <- data.frame(
    interval_start = surv_estimates$time[-n],
    interval_end = surv_estimates$time[-1],
    S_t_prev = surv_estimates$surv_prob[-n],
    S_t_curr = surv_estimates$surv_prob[-1]
  )
  hz_df$duration <- hz_df$interval_end - hz_df$interval_start
  valid_rows <- hz_df$duration > 0 & hz_df$S_t_prev > 0
  hz_df <- hz_df[which(valid_rows), ]
  hz_df$hazard_rate <- (hz_df$S_t_prev - hz_df$S_t_curr) / (hz_df$S_t_prev * hz_df$duration)
  return(
    data.frame(
      interval_start = hz_df$interval_start,
      interval_end = hz_df$interval_end,
      hazard_rate = hz_df$hazard_rate
    )
  )
}

Mjs <- episodes %>% 
  group_by(cc, sv, sex) %>% 
  group_modify( ~ 
    {
      cat(paste0(.y[1, ], collapse = ', '), '\n')
      purrr::map_dfr(c('M', 'S', 'D', 'W'), \(x) 
      {
        .x %>%
          filter(A == 'M', fit != 7) %>% 
          mutate(
            l =  start,
            u =  case_when(
              A == Z ~ Inf,
              Z != x ~ Inf,
              Z == x ~ end,
            )
          ) -> tmp
        if (nrow(tmp) != 0) {
          o = icenReg::ic_np(tmp[, c('l', 'u')], weights = tmp$n) 
          o = hz_np(o)
          o$Z <- x
        }
        else {
          o = data.frame(interval_start = 0, interval_end = 0, hazard_rate = 0)
          o$Z <- x
        }
        o
      }) %>% 
      transmute(
        A = 'M', 
        Z = Z,
        start = interval_start, 
        p_empirical = hazard_rate
      )
    }
  )

write.csv(Mjs, file = here('data', 'mjs.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
```
